title: Factorized PDE-coefficient × boundary-condition operator views
hypothesis: For a 1D Poisson solution operator, one shared low-dimensional function basis plus factorized coefficient and boundary-condition coordinates can recover held-out coefficient×boundary combinations at lower actual bytes than storing each solution map independently.
physical_object: shared basis/trunk over spatial coordinate x
controls: direct coefficient/boundary conditioned DeepONet-style shared operator
factorized Mirror coordinates with shared spatial basis
exact analytical PDE solver upper control
task: Solve -kappa*u''=1 on [0,1], u(0)=L, u(1)=R. Evaluate held-out parameter combinations and PDE residual on a fixed spatial grid. The exact solution is u=(1-x)L+xR+x(1-x)/(2*kappa).

development.selection_metric: Validate basis and numerical encoding on development combinations; no fresh combination used for design changes.

fresh.split: Each world samples 16 coefficient-boundary task combinations. Training combinations cover coefficient and boundary marginals; test contains held-out cross-combinations. Each combination evaluated at 64 fixed x-grid points.

success_gate: On >=2/3 fresh worlds, held-out solution MSE <=1e-8, PDE residual <=1e-6, and factorized bank actual bytes <=60% of independent sampled maps. Mirror-specific evidence additionally requires improved quality/bytes/compute over direct DeepONet-style conditioning.
failure_gate: FAIL if quality or storage gate fails in >=2/3 worlds, or if the direct coefficient/boundary-conditioned operator matches the Mirror function and Pareto point.
boundaries: held-out combinations test algebraic composition, not learned generalization
logical combination count is not capacity
